text.en:
Except as hereinafter provided, all provisions of law now or hereafter applicable to regular
provinces shall be applicable to the province of Basilan.

The Regional Commissioner of Region IX is hereby authorized to reappoint, redesignate or
reassign employees of the provincial and municipal governments and to recommend to the President of the
Philippines the reappointment, redesignation or reassignment of incumbent elective officials such that the
governmental framework in the province remains unimpaired and effective. Such employees and officials
reappointed, redesignated or reassigned shall hold office until their successors shall have been appointed or
elected in accordance with the law, unless sooner removed for cause by the Regional Commissioner in the

case of employees of the provincial and municipal governments, or by the President of the Philippines upon
the recommendation of the Regional Commissioner in the case of elective officials.

Employees of the National Government assigned in the Province of Basilan shall be reappointed,
redesignated or reassigned in accordance with the provisions of appropriate law.

The amount of one million seven hundred twenty thousand pesos (P1,720,000.00) is hereby
authorized to be appropriated from funds in the National Treasury not otherwise appropriated.

The Regional Commissioner is hereby authorized to reallocate or reassign the use of existing
properties, buildings, equipment and other effects of the provincial and municipal governments to the different
municipalities until such time as the formal turnover of these properties to the pertinent political subdivisions
is finalized in accordance with applicable administrative rules or regulations therefor.

This Decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 11th day of December, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-five.
